items.title: Cell biochemistry beyond membranes: Condensate physics reveals general rules for chemical responses
items.abstract: Basic biology courses teach that cells contain organelles—such as the nucleus, mitochondria and Golgi apparatus—set apart by lipid membranes to get things done. Recent cell biology research has revealed another organizational principle at work in cells across all orders of biology.

items.title: Muon g-2 experiment places new constraints on a forbidden property of muons
items.abstract: A year after its final muon magnetic anomaly announcement, the Muon g-2 collaboration reports a new measurement of a different property of the muon: its electric dipole moment. The work is published on the arXiv preprint server.
